(Bristol, Connecticut) | college = [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn]] (2022–2024) | draft_year = 2024 | draft_round = 1 | draft_pick = 7 | draft_team = [[Portland Trail Blazers]] | career_start = 2024 | career_end = | years1 = {{nbay|2024|start}}–present | team1 = [[Portland Trail Blazers]] | highlights = * [[NBA All-Rookie Team|NBA All-Rookie Second Team]] ({{nbay|2024|end}}) * 2× [[NCAA champion]] ([[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2023]], [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2024]]) * [[Associated Press|AP]] Honorable Mention [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] ([[2024 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2024]]) * [[Big East]] All-Freshman team (2023) }} '''Donovan John Clingan''' (born February 23, 2004) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn Huskies]], winning two consecutive national championships in 2023 and 2024. ==Early life and high school career== Clingan grew up in [[Bristol, Connecticut]], and attended [[Bristol Central High School]], where he led the boys basketball team to a 2022 Connecticut Interscholastic Athletic Conference Division II state championship.{{cite web |last=Gibson |first=Charlotte |date=May 8, 2020 |title=Donovan Clingan contends with basketball future, his late mother's memory |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28723706 |access-date=March 22, 2023 |website=[[ESPN.com]]}}{{Cite news |last=Anthony |first=Mike |title=Donovan Clingan is the 7-foot-3 face of UConn basketball. He's still a small town CT kid at heart. |url=https://www.ctinsider.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/article/donovan-clingan-uconn-men-s-basketball-18424508.php |access-date=May 17, 2024 |work=CT Insider |language=en}} Clingan averaged 27.3 points, 17.2 rebounds and 5.8 blocks per game as a junior and was named the Connecticut Gatorade Player of the Year.{{cite web |last=Morelli |first=Joe |date=June 4, 2021 |title=Bristol Central's Donovan Clingan Gatorade State Player of Year, 1 of 3 finalists for national award |url=https://www.ctpost.com/sports/article/Bristol-Central-s-Donovan-Clingan-Gatorade-16224029.php |access-date=March 22, 2023 |work=[[Connecticut Post]] |archive-date=March 22, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230322172719/https://www.ctpost.com/sports/article/Bristol-Central-s-Donovan-Clingan-Gatorade-16224029.php |url-status=dead }} Clingan repeated as the Connecticut Gatorade Player of the Year after averaging 30.3 points, 18.4 rebounds and 6.2 blocks per game during his senior season.{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/03/21/sports/ncaabasketball/march-madness-uconn-clingan.html|title=UConn's Freshman Center Stands Out Off the Bench|first=Adam|last=Zagoria|work=[[The New York Times]]|date=March 22, 2023|access-date=March 22, 2023}} On July 2, 2021, he committed to playing college basketball for [[UConn Huskies men's basketball|UConn]] over offers from [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]], [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State]], [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]], [[Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball|Georgetown]], [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]], [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence]] and [[Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball|Rutgers]].{{cite web |date=July 2, 2021 |title=Bristol Central center Donovan Clingan commits to UConn |url=https://www.theday.com/uconn-mens-basketball/20210702/bristol-central-center-donovan-clingan-commits-to-uconn/ |url-status=dead |access-date=March 22, 2023 |work=[[The Day (New London)|The Day]] |archive-date=March 22, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230322172719/https://www.theday.com/uconn-mens-basketball/20210702/bristol-central-center-donovan-clingan-commits-to-uconn/ }} Clingan grew up with and is close friends with current [[UConn Huskies football]] running back Victor Rosa. Rosa was Clingan's point guard in high school, and was a record-breaking football player as well.{{cite web |last=Anthony |first=Mike |date=October 25, 2023 |title=The new face of UConn basketball is a 7-foot-3 phenom from CT |url=https://www.ctinsider.com/connecticutmagazine/news-people/article/donovan-clingan-uconn-men-s-basketball-18424508.php |access-date=January 6, 2025 |website=ctinsider.com}} ==College career== Clingan entered his freshman season at UConn as the Huskies' backup center behind [[Adama Sanogo]].{{cite web|url=https://www.journalinquirer.com/sports/college/uconn_mens_basketball/uconn-notebook-clingan-makes-big-first-impression/article_db3d6470-5f46-11ed-8c74-9f305d4c3166.html|title=UConn Notebook: Clingan makes big firs impression|first=Adam|last=Betz|work=[[Journal Inquirer]]|date=November 8, 2022|access-date=March 22, 2023}} He was named to the [[Big East Conference]] All-Freshman team at the end of the regular season.{{cite web|url=https://www.courant.com/2023/03/05/uconns-adama-sanogo-jordan-hawkins-named-first-team-all-big-east-karaban-clingan-on-all-freshman-team|title=UConn's Adama Sanogo, Jordan Hawkins named First Team All-Big East; Karaban, Clingan on All-Freshman team|first=Joe|last=Arruda|work=[[Hartford Courant]]|date=March 5, 2023|access-date=March 22, 2023}} Clingan scored four points with three rebounds, a block and two steals in the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball championship game|2023 national championship game]] as the Huskies won 76–59.{{cite web |last=Borges |first=David |date=April 4, 2023 |title=Donovan Clingan makes good on promise, helps UConn men's basketball team 'get No. 5' |url=https://www.stamfordadvocate.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/article/donovan-clingan-national-championship-dan-hurley-17877175.php |access-date=April 4, 2023 |work=[[Stamford Advocate]]}} Although he was considered to be a likely selection in the [[2023 NBA draft]], he decided to return to UConn for his sophomore season.{{cite web |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |date=April 8, 2023 |title=UConn center Donovan Clingan to return for sophomore season |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/36121847 |access-date=April 10, 2023 |website=[[ESPN.com]]}} Clingan entered his sophomore year as UConn's starting center.{{cite web|url=https://www.ctinsider.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/article/donovan-clingan-huskies-start-18472906.php|title=Donovan Clingan reflects on first start for UConn men's basketball team: 'Dream come true'|first=David|last=Borges|website=CT Insider|date=November 7, 2023|access-date=November 13, 2023}}{{cite web |last=Arruda |first=Joe |date=November 4, 2023 |title=UConn men's preview: Donovan Clingan, the Huskies' ultimate big man, out to prove he's ready for the big time |url=https://www.courant.com/2023/11/04/uconn-mens-preview-donovan-clingan-the-huskies-ultimate-big-man-out-to-prove-hes-ready-for-the-big-time/ |access-date=November 13, 2023 |work=[[Hartford Courant]]}} He suffered a foot injury in a game against Seton Hall on December 20, 2023.{{cite web |last=Borzello |first=Jeff |date=December 23, 2023 |title=UConn center Donovan Clingan out 3-4 weeks with foot injury |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39173855 |access-date=April 10, 2024 |website=[[ESPN.com]]}} Clingan returned on January 17, 2024, scoring six points and grabbing five rebounds in 16 minutes of play in a 62–48 win over 18th-ranked [[2023–24 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]].{{cite web |date=January 17, 2024 |others=Contributed by The Associated Press |title=Clingan returns from injury to help No. 1 UConn stop Creighton |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/39332658 |access-date=April 10, 2024 |website=[[ESPN.com]]}} On April 12, 2024, Clingan declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{cite web |last=Wojnarowski |first=Adrian |author-link=Adrian Wojnarowski |date=April 12, 2024 |title=UConn center Donovan Clingan entering NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/39929419 |access-date=April 12, 2024 |website=ESPN.com}} ==Professional career== === Portland Trail Blazers (2024–present) === ===2024–25 season: Rookie season=== Clingan was selected with the seventh overall pick by the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] in the [[2024 NBA draft]].{{cite web |first=Aaron |last=Fentress |title=Trail Blazers select center Donovan Clingan with the No. 7 pick in the NBA draft |url=https://www.oregonlive.com/blazers/2024/06/trail-blazers-select-center-donovan-clingan-with-the-no-7-pick-in-the-nba-draft.html |work=[[The Oregonian]] |date=June 26, 2024 |access-date=June 27, 2024}} With his college number 32 retired by the Trail Blazers for [[Bill Walton]], Clingan chose 23 as his jersey number.{{cite tweet|first=Casey|last=Holdahl|title=Also of note: Donovan Clingan will wear no. 23|number=1806728865198571721|user=CHold|date=June 28, 2024|access-date= June 28, 2024}} On July 4, he signed with Portland.{{cite web|title=Trail Blazers Sign Donovan Clingan|url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/trail-blazers-sign-donovan-clingan|website=NBA.com|date=July 4, 2024|access-date=July 5, 2024}} Clingan participated on the Trail Blazers summer league team and was named to the [[NBA Summer League#Las Vegas All Summer League Teams|All-NBA Summer League]] Second Team.{{Cite web |title=NBA 2K25 All-Summer League teams announced {{!}} NBA.com |url=https://www.nba.com/news/nba-2k25-all-summer-league-teams-announced |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=NBA |language=en}} Clingan made his NBA debut on October 23, 2024, in a 140–104 loss to the [[Golden State Warriors]].{{cite web|title=Golden State Warriors at Portland Trail Blazers Box Score, October 23, 2024|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202410230POR.html|website=BasketballRef|access-date=November 1, 2024}} On November 12, Clingan made his first career start in a win against the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{Cite web |title=Minnesota Timberwolves vs Portland Trail Blazers Nov 12, 2024 Box Scores |url=https://www.nba.com/game/min-vs-por-0022400008 |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=NBA |language=en}} In the next game on November 13, Clingan again started and recorded career highs in both blocks (8) and points (17) in another win against the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{Cite web |title=Minnesota Timberwolves vs Portland Trail Blazers Nov 13, 2024 Box Scores |url=https://www.nba.com/game/min-vs-por-0022400226 |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=NBA |language=en}} At seasons end, Clingan led all rookies in both total blocks (110) and blocks per game (1.6).{{Cite web |title=2024-25 NBA Player Stats: Per Game |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2025_per_game.html |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=Basketball-Reference.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=2024-25 NBA Player Stats: Totals |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2025_totals.html |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=Basketball-Reference.com |language=en}} Clingan became the first Trail Blazers rookie since [[Damian Lillard]] to earn All Rookie honors when he was named to the [[NBA All-Rookie Team|NBA All-Rookie]] Second Team.{{Cite web |title=2024-25 NBA All-Rookie teams |url=https://www.nba.com/news/2024-25-all-rookie-teams-announced |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=NBA |language=en}} ===2025–26 season: Full-time starter=== On October 21, 2025, the Trail Blazers exercised their 2026-27 team option on Clingan.{{Cite web |last=Newby |first=Judah |date=2025-10-21 |title=Trail Blazers Officially Announce Exercising Of Team Options On Scoot Henderson, Kris Murray and Donovan Clingan |url=https://www.750thegame.com/trail-blazers-officially-announce-exercising-of-team-options-on-scoot-henderson-kris-murray-and-donovan-clingan/ |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=750 The Game |language=en-US}} After not being selected for the [[Rising Stars Challenge]] in his rookie season, Clingan was selected to compete in the [[Rising Stars Challenge#2026 roster|2026 Rising Stars Challenge]] at All Star Weekend in [[Inglewood, California]].{{Cite web |title=Donovan Clingan And Yang Hansen Selected To Compete In 2026 Castrol Rising Stars {{!}} Portland Trail Blazers |url=https://blazers.com/news/donovan-clingan-and-yang-hansen-selected-to-compete-in-2026-castrol-rising-stars |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=blazers.com |language=en}} On March 18, 2026, Clingan recorded a career–high 28 points in a win against the [[2025–26 Indiana Pacers season|Indiana Pacers]].{{Cite web |title=Portland Trail Blazers vs Indiana Pacers Mar 18, 2026 Game Summary |url=https://www.nba.com/game/por-vs-ind-0022501001 |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=NBA |language=en}} At seasons end, Clingan set the Trail Blazers franchise single-season records for total offensive rebounds (347) and offensive rebounds per game (4.5), also leading the NBA in both categories.{{Cite web |title=2025-26 NBA Player Stats: Totals |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2026_totals.html |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=Basketball-Reference.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Portland Trail Blazers Season Leaders |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/teams/POR/leaders_season.html |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=Basketball-Reference.com |language=en}} He also finished fifth in the league in blocks per game (1.7).{{Cite web |title=2025-26 NBA Player Stats: Per Game |url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/leagues/NBA_2026_per_game.html |access-date=2026-04-13 |website=Basketball-Reference.com 1.0 || .5 || 2.1 || 9.8 {{S-end}} ==Personal life== Clingan is the son of Bill and Stacey Porrini Clingan. He has one younger sister, Olivia.{{cite web |title=Donovan Clingan - Men's Basketball |url=https://uconnhuskies.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/donovan-clingan/13276 |website=University of Connecticut Athletics |access-date=July 26, 2024 |language=en}} Clingan's mother, Stacey Clingan, also played basketball at Bristol Central where she set school records for career rebounds and blocks before playing college basketball at the [[Maine Black Bears women's basketball|University of Maine]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4332941/2023/03/22/uconn-donovan-clingan-sweet-16/|title=Donovan Clingan is UConn's next big star. His mom would have loved it|first=Dana|last=O'Neil|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=March 22, 2023|access-date=March 22, 2023}} Stacey Clingan died of breast cancer in March 2018.{{Cite web |last=Doyle |first=Paul |date=April 1, 2023 |title=UConn men's basketball freshman Donovan Clingan honoring late mother at Final Four: "Make her proud' |url=https://www.stamfordadvocate.com/sports/uconn-mens-basketball/final-four/article/final-four-donovan-clingan-houston-huskies-17872157.php |access-date=April 3, 2023 |website=[[Stamford Advocate]]}} Clingan wore number 32, his mother's number, in Bristol and at UConn.{{Cite web |last=Arruda |first=Joe |date=June 29, 2024 |title=Former UConn, Bristol Central star Donovan Clingan introduced as a Portland Trail Blazer |url=https://www.courant.com/2024/06/29/former-uconn-bristol-central-star-donovan-clingan-introduced-as-a-portland-trail-blazer/ |access-date=July 8, 2024 |website=Hartford Courant |language=en-US}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{basketballstats|nba=1642270|bbr=c/clingdo01}} *[https://uconnhuskies.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/donovan-clingan/13276 UConn Huskies bio] {{Portland Trail Blazers current roster}} {{navboxes|list= {{2023 UConn Huskies men's basketball navbox}} {{2024 UConn Huskies men's basketball navbox}} {{2024 NBA draft}} }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Clingan, Donovan}} [[Category:2004 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Hartford County, Connecticut]] [[Category:Bristol Central High School alumni]] [[Category:Centers (basketball)]] [[Category:Portland Trail Blazers draft picks]] [[Category:Portland Trail Blazers players]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Bristol, Connecticut]] [[Category:UConn Huskies men's basketball players]]
